verdict.rationale: Numeral ships automated compliance features such as autofile and autoregister, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence pack documents nothing of the kind. Dated API versions, refund reversals, and filings awaiting review are adjacent features, not version control or rollback of user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
